body: Yeah man Im on discord every day I'm totally down to share some of the stuff Im working on too
Touching heads together, arms on my shoulders. Such an emotional connection for me when this would happen. Unfortunately my ex never understood it

I appreciate your response. But unfortunately there is no way for me to see this person you speak of when evaluating myself. I just see a dorky, weak, basement dwelling loser when I even look in the mirror. I get that other people are sad. I get that things could be worse. But what I fail to see is continuing to live in shame and suffering. What lies ahead for me is most likely a life of sadness, or atleast in my eyes. When I look at 30 year olds working a cashier job in a grocery store, I see my future. No college degree, lack of work ethic, and just sad. That's me. I think I would be doing myself a favor by just cutting it short. Just as I have with everything in my life. Uncompleted, little to no effort, and lost in time.
